name: Persistent-fear funding-soft swing (deeper hold, BB-z stretch confirm)
rationale: A longer-horizon swing variant of the niche aimed at multi-week mean reversion rather than a fast bounce. Arm a long when Fear&Greed is fearful AND funding is soft (below ceiling, uncrowded) AND price is statistically STRETCHED below its mean (Bollinger z-score below a negative floor) — fear+funding establish the contrarian positioning context, bb_z confirms price is meaningfully extended to the downside (a measured stretch, not a single bad bar). All three BOUNDED; bb_z is a z-score so lt against a negative floor is the correct level op; funding ceiling straddles realized to bite (null carry). Longer min/max hold harvests the slower reversion and keeps turnover low so fees barely bite. DISCONFIRMER: a bb_z-only deep-stretch reversion long (no fear, no funding) is in this cohort — if bb_z-alone matches the deflated/holdout Sharpe, the fear and funding legs add nothing beyond what a Bollinger statistical-stretch reversion already captures, and the positioning+sentiment thesis is unsupported. Exit when bb_z reverts to its mean OR sentiment recovers. Holdout must hold. Gate disposes.
catalyst: persistent fear + soft funding + price stretched below its Bollinger mean
